description: This file contains shell script functions and configurations for setting up and managing PPP (Point-to-Point Protocol) connections, including various PPP protocols like pppoe, pppoa, pptp, and serial device PPP. It defines functions for initialization, setup, teardown, and utility conversions related to PPP.

methods.name: ppp_select_ipaddr
methods.description: Selects an IP address from a list of subnets based on subnet masks.

methods.name: ppp_exitcode_tostring
methods.description: Converts PPP exit codes to human-readable strings.

methods.name: ppp_generic_setup
methods.description: Sets up a PPP connection with provided configuration and options.

methods.name: ppp_generic_teardown
methods.description: Tears down a PPP connection and handles error notifications.
